capabilities: Scan vault Markdown files for a configurable marker keyword
Show all matches in a sidebar grouped by the note's first frontmatter tag
Open the source note at the marker's line
Remove a marker's entire source line via its completion button
Drag markers between tag groups to update the note's tag
extras: Completing a marker deletes the whole source line with no built-in undo or archive; the README warns to back up notes. Installation from the Community directory is described as pending publication ('After Cairn is published').
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that gathers TODO-marked lines from across the vault into one reviewable list near the notes they belong to.
summary: Sidebar that collects TODO keyword markers from vault Markdown notes, groups them by frontmatter tag, and links back to the source lines.
